seed_and_initial_state_protocol.seed_rule: The listed fixed seed is applied to the environment and episode i uses the official task init_state i.
seed_and_initial_state_protocol.test_information_visibility: The policy receives only its declared online observation and task language; it does not receive seed, init state, success, reward, or future data.

camera_preprocessing.camera_gating: agentview observable is active only while refreshing a planning observation; it is disabled during intervening open-loop chunk actions.

action_protocol.execution: receding-horizon execution; plan a new chunk when the previous chunk is exhausted
action_protocol.logging: Record pre-clipping element counts and ratios per episode, task, and run.

comparability_rule: Do not compare a parallel_envs>1 rollout directly to formal parallel_envs=1 results; batched fp16 numerical rounding can change borderline trajectories.
